notes: Used ForJournals_a/Data/Clean/uctdata_balanced.dta (499 students x 2 rounds; follow-up round 2 rows carry outcomes, baseline IAT in *bas variables). Attempt-1: exploratory variable listing. Attempt-2: crashed (helper function named se shadowed fixest::se). Attempt-3: all estimates; check_attempt reported all claims within tolerance, but Table 4 N was 493/106/324 because fixest drops singleton academic-program FE cells by default; final run sets fixef.rm='none' (as OLS with program dummies), giving N=499/117/332 as in the paper, unchanged coefficients, and SEs and R2 matching the paper's Table 4. Spec: OLS, own controls (female, UCT score/1000, durable-goods PCA wealth index, consumption, foreign, private school, with mean-imputation and missing dummies as supplied in the data), roommate controls (same minus female), residence FE (subsamples) or race-group x residence FE plus White/Coloured/Indian-Other dummies (full sample), academic program FE for Table 4, baseline IAT for Table 3; SEs clustered by baseline room. GPA and the performance index (PCAperf) taken as provided in the data file. No hangs; each sandbox run took under 2 s.
